name: Serving
overview: Scripture teaches that serving is an exclusive and wholehearted commitment to God, as Joshua exhorts believers to serve the LORD with all their heart and soul (Joshua 22:5; 24:15). Jesus emphasizes that no one can serve two masters, underscoring the necessity of undivided loyalty to God rather than worldly wealth (Matthew 6:24). Furthermore, Christ models serving others sacrificially, coming not to be served but to serve and give His life for many (Matthew 20:28; Mark 10:45), and calls His followers to embrace humility by becoming servants of all (Mark 9:35). This teaching encompasses serving God directly, serving others in humility, and rejecting service to false gods or divided allegiances.
